Definition: {to dominate, i.e. govern; by implication, to permit}
BiblicalUsage: To rule, in Daniel's Aramaic, is what God gives and takes away. He made Nebuchadnezzar ruler over all, and made Daniel ruler over the whole province of Babylon, and the king offered rule to whoever could read the writing. But the accusers who had the mastery of Daniel found the lions had the mastery of them.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe rule is a loan from God. He gives it to Nebuchadnezzar and to Daniel, and He takes it from the accusers, and I hold that no ruler holds it except by His hand.
